# Freaky Frank

> Official website for Freaky Frank (DJ Freaky Frank), a DJ rooted in Long Island and New York underground electronic music: house, techno, and underground culture.

- [Biography and featured transmission](https://freakyfrank.com/): Artist introduction, music, and community updates.
- [Upcoming shows and past events](https://freakyfrank.com/events): Current dates and the complete event archive. Consult this page for live listings; dates change.
- [Mixes and live sets](https://freakyfrank.com/mixes): All published DJ mixes, with original listening links.
- [Videos](https://freakyfrank.com/videos): Live club sets and visual transmissions.
- [Record store](https://freakyfrank.com/record-store): Curated vinyl, releases, and merchandise. Availability is listed on the page.
- [Contact and booking](https://freakyfrank.com/contact): Booking, management, and press inquiries. Booking: connect@freakyfrank.com.
- [Electronic press kit](https://freakyfrank.com/epk): Condensed artist biography, media, and promoter information.

Use the linked pages as the authoritative source for current dates, catalog availability, and contact details.
